clue.text: Mayan beheaded an old man round island resort

indicators.note: the shortened Mayan goes around the island's letter
with its head cut off, the word Mayan loses its first letter

parts.note: pa is an informal word for father, one's old man

explanation.surface: A headless Mayan and an elderly man gather around an island holiday spot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'beheaded' strips M from Mayan to leave AYAN, and 'round' puts I inside it to give AIYAN. Ayia Napa is a party resort in Cyprus, here spelt as one word.
explanation.definitionFit: Aiyanapa (Ayia Napa) is a well-known beach holiday town in Cyprus, so it is an example of a resort.

clue.text: Sex game dumps me in country canal

indicators.note: the six-plus-shortened-game piece sits inside the word for a country

parts.note: a nation is a country
VI is six in Roman numerals, and sex is Latin for six

indicators.note: to dump something is to get rid of it, so the letters of me leave the word game

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: An adult game with a person dropping out happens in a rural canal setting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sex' looks risqué but is Latin for six. 'dumps' takes the letters of 'me' out of the game word, and 'in' puts the result inside the country.
explanation.definitionFit: In British usage a navigation is an artificial waterway, so a canal can be called a navigation.

clue.text: Soldiers thus on retreat stop Roman bull, that ancient creature

indicators.note: the soldiers piece plugs, or stops up, the bull word as a filling

parts.note: taurus is the Latin word for bull
OR stands for other ranks, ordinary soldiers

indicators.note: retreating means going backwards, so the word for thus is turned round

parts.note: so means thus

explanation.surface: Retreating troops try to halt a charging Roman bull, a beast from long ago.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on retreat' turns only the word for thus; 'stop' plugs the soldiers piece into the bull word after its first letter. Torosaurus was a horned dinosaur.
explanation.definitionFit: Torosaurus was a large horned dinosaur of the late Cretaceous, a prehistoric beast long extinct.

clue.text: Girl injured at the start — arm dislocated

indicators.note: at the start picks only the opening letter of the word injured
a dislocated arm is put out of place, so its letters are shifted around

explanation.surface: A girl hurt early on has put her arm out of joint.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue text held here lost the word 'injured', which the puzzle's blog quotes as part of the clue.
explanation.definitionFit: Irma is a female first name, as in the film Irma la Douce, so it can stand for a girl.

clue.text: Writer Bloom dismisses hollow idea

indicators.note: to dismiss is to send away, so these letters are taken out of the flower

parts.note: a dahlia is a garden flower, a bloom

indicators.note: hollowed out, the word idea keeps only its first and last letters

explanation.surface: An author called Bloom throws out an empty notion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hollow idea' leaves IA (the outer letters of IDEA), which 'dismisses' takes out of DAHLIA. 'Bloom' looks like a surname, but it is the flower.
explanation.definitionFit: Roald Dahl was a British author of children's books such as Matilda, so he is a writer.

clue.text: Emilia's man gets one back

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
ago means back in time, as in years back

explanation.surface: Emilia's husband takes back one of something.
explanation.walkthrough: Emilia is the wife of the villain in Shakespeare's Othello.
explanation.definitionFit: In Othello the scheming ensign is married to Emilia, Desdemona's attendant, so he is her husband.

clue.text: First in pub beset by insults drinks noisily

indicators.note: to be beset is to be surrounded, so the letter sits inside the insults

parts.note: slurs are insults

indicators.note: first in takes just the opening letter of the following word, pub

explanation.surface: In a pub surrounded by abuse, someone drinks loudly.
explanation.definitionFit: To slurp is to drink with a loud sucking noise, so the verb forms match.

clue.text: Emperor has trouble with king on north-south road

indicators.note: in an across clue on means placed after, so the king follows the road

parts.note: the M1 is England's main north-south motorway, written MI in crosswords
K is the chess abbreviation for king
ado means fuss or trouble

explanation.walkthrough: The M1 is a motorway running from London to Leeds; crosswords write its 1 as the letter I.
explanation.definitionFit: Mikado is an old title for the Emperor of Japan, used in English since the 1700s.

explanation.walkthrough: The clue text held here lost the word 'revolutionary', which the puzzle's blog quotes as the reversal signal.

clue.text: Cricket side needing every boundary's crawling along

explanation.walkthrough: In cricket a ball that reaches the boundary rope after bouncing scores four runs, and is called a boundary or a four.
explanation.definitionFit: Going on hands and knees, as a baby does, is crawling, and the phrase also describes moving that way.

clue.text: Airlines association has origins in Italy and the Adriatic

explanation.walkthrough: A cobbler shapes shoes on a last; making size seventeen shoes puts him at a long last.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means eventually, after much delay, which is what finally means.

clue.text: Unknown state car a follower enters?

explanation.definitionFit: Limbo is a state of uncertainty, where the outcome is not yet known.

clue.text: Movement that of animals circling track from the south?

indicators.note: the rearranged animals go around the turned track
that refers back to movement, so the phrase means a movement of the letters of animals, a rearrangement
read from the south in a down clue means upwards, so the track word goes backwards

parts.note: a rut is a sunken track or groove

explanation.walkthrough: 'that of' borrows 'Movement' to mean a movement of ANIMALS, an anagram; 'from the south' turns RUT into TUR, which the rearranged letters surround.
explanation.definitionFit: Naturalism is an art and literary movement favouring faithful, realistic depiction of life.

clue.text: Line in this funny with mad British comedienne

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

clue.text: Some Canadian in Fijian town

clue.text: Lion in Narnia, disheartened after rejection, creates massive agency

clue.text: Reason to do broadcast just outside?
